subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Lesson 7: Skills – Reading: life on the International Space Station
outcomes: Read a text about life on the International Space Station.
Find facts and numbers in the text and correct false sentences.
Plan and explain choices for a space trip.

tf.why: The International Space Station is a satellite.

tf.s: The ISS goes around the Earth once every 90 minutes.
tf.why: It goes around the Earth every 90 minutes.

tf.s: Astronauts on the ISS see 24 sunrises every 16 hours.
tf.why: They see 16 sunrises or sunsets every 24 hours.

tf.s: The ISS travels at 28,000 kilometres per hour.
tf.why: It is very fast: 28,000 kilometres per hour.

tf.s: Astronauts don't need to exercise on the ISS.
tf.why: They exercise for two hours a day to keep their muscles strong.

tf.s: In space, muscles can become very weak.
tf.why: Astronauts are weightless, so their muscles can become weak.

tf.s: ISS means the International Space Station.
Astronauts on the ISS exercise for ten minutes a week.
tf.why: They exercise for two hours a day.

tf.s: For the trip to Mars, everything must fit in a box one metre high, wide and deep.
tf.why: That is the problem in the planning task.

tf.s: The ISS goes around the Moon.
tf.why: The ISS goes around the Earth.

mcq.why: The International Space Station is a satellite.

mcq.q: How fast does the ISS travel?
mcq.why: The ISS travels at 28,000 kilometres per hour.

mcq.q: How long do astronauts exercise every day?
mcq.why: They exercise for two hours a day.

mcq.q: How big is the box for the trip to Mars?
o: one metre high, wide and deep
mcq.why: Everything must fit in a one-metre box.

mcq.q: Correct this sentence: Astronauts can see 24 sunrises every 16 hours.
o: They see 16 sunrises or sunsets every 24 hours.
They see one sunrise every day.

mcq.q: You will go to Mars for a long time. Which reason is good for taking a photo of your family?
mcq.why: A family photo helps when you miss your family.

mcq.q: Complete: The ISS goes around the Earth once every ______ minutes.
mcq.why: It goes around once every 90 minutes.

mcq.q: Why can astronauts' muscles become very weak in space?
o: They are weightless, so their muscles don't work hard.
mcq.why: Without weight, muscles don't work hard, so astronauts exercise.

mcq.q: Why do astronauts see many sunrises in one day?
o: The ISS goes around the Earth very fast.
The ISS stops near the Sun.
They have a lot of lamps.
mcq.why: It goes around the Earth every 90 minutes, so the Sun rises many times.

mcq.q: The box is small. Which thing is the best choice for the trip to Mars?
o: a book for your free time
mcq.why: Small, useful things fit in the box.
